shared_elements: circular/disc motifs (roundel on A, chariot wheels on B)
horizontal incised bands or dividing lines
justification: Both are weathered stone surfaces worked in shallow relief and both include circular/disc forms and roughly human figures, which is about as far as the correspondence goes. A is a single vertical boulder-like block with sparse, crude, isolated motifs and one dominant roundel, whereas B is a broad wall organised into strict horizontal registers of finely detailed, repetitive processional figures, chariots and animals — an entirely different compositional logic and level of craft.
